V1.2 trust hardening correctly refuses to bind identity on synthetic observations (identity_bound=False) and downgrades CONFIRMED to INCONCLUSIVE, so no promotion occurs and the synthetic-30-decision campaign yields 0 promotions. This is the INTENDED trust-hardening behavior documented in TEAM1_AVI_V1_2_TRUST_HARDENING.md section 9 (pre-existing, unchanged by this closure). Not hidden, not modified.
